title: Two forecasts of China's wind. Both wrong.
description:
A straight line said 333 TWh for 2020. A growth curve said 1,039. The real number was 467.
Both models saw only 2010 to 2014. Test a forecast yourself: https://rimilab.com/#/mba/forecasting
Data: Ember and Energy Institute, via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0).
